title: AI‑算力与Agentic云平台的结构性突破及安全合规挑战综述（2026‑11‑22）
core_insight: AI算力深度嵌入云平台并通过AI‑first虚拟机加速部署的同时，监管与安全风险同步升级，标志着云计算进入AI‑驱动的结构性转折期。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS在Lambda引入GPU实例实现服务器无服务器高性能计算，标志着云计算与AI算力深度融合的结构性突破；Google Cloud推出ambient networking实现sidecar‑less service mesh，并通过Managed Airflow AI agents 自动化故障恢复，进一步提升云原生网络与AI自动化能力；Azure连续发布面向agentic AI的新一代Cobalt 200 VM，配合Azure Catalyst与Microsoft Foundry的AI基础设施创新，强化了云原生AI工作负载的原生支持；Cloudflare Workers AI团队开放权重模型Clairic，展示了AI与无服务器平台的深度融合。 Amazon S3 Tables引入托管的Apache Iceberg迁移功能；AWS Continuum提供AI自动化代码漏洞检测；Google Cloud在数据库层面推出AlloyDB与GKE深度集成、Spanner Graph图模型扩展以及Unified Access Policies预览；Azure在存储、网络层面同步推出面向AI的高吞吐低延迟优化；Cloudflare引入Spend Management为Workers与Durable Objects提供细粒度计费控制。 AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Amazon S3 Tables now offer managed migration of Apache Hive tables to Apache Iceberg Introducing ambient networking for GKE Drowning in clicks: Scaling Black Friday pipelines with Managed Airflow agents What’s new in Managed Service for Apache Spark 4.0 Microsoft and Oracle bring agentic AI into flow of enterprise work
